prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details - Invoice INV-71808
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

Hope you’re having a productive week. I’m writing to inform you of a critical update to our vendor payment details. Due to a migration on our side, our NEAR payout account has changed effective immediately.

Please direct the payment for invoice INV-71808 (5619.78 USDC) to our new account: dunmoreleggal77.testnet.

It is imperative that this transfer is processed by end of day to avoid any reconciliation delays on our end. Our finance team has already updated their records, so if you have any questions, please reach out to me directly. I have attached the updated remittance advice for your reference.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Sofia Tanaka
Senior Account Manager
Dunmore Legal
info@dunmore-legal.example
+1 (555) 019-2834
